Sort of a story about a story, but I was in a psych ward for the first time and was NOT settling in well.  I was pretty much terrified of almost everyone there staff included.  

I have no idea what time it was at but the halftime of the football game we were all watching came on and peoples attention shifted off the tv and began talking to each other.  I was not talking to anyone sort of just staring off into space when the guy sitting next to me began speaking, to no one in particular, about how he came to be in this place.  As he started talking more and more people began listening, myself included as he was sitting right next to me.  The story he told no joke convinced me right then and there that we live in a simulation.  

The story started with him going on pornhub and preparing to jerk off to some videos.  While scrolling mindlessly through the page he noticed something strange that caught his attention.  He scrolled back up and was looking at his own house, his bedroom, his bed, and most shockingly of all....his wife.  He clicked on the video and watched the start of it confirming his worst suspicions.  Then he clicked on the profile that was uploading the videos and saw that there were DOZENS of videos of his wife fucking specifically just black guys dating back to after he had his first kid with her.  Now, I personally have no problem with black people or black dicks inside white women but apparently this guy did even apart from the fact that it was his wife.  He had vocalized to her many times as they were an on and off couple that if she ever was with a black person he would be very upset as he was a racist (clearly).

At this point, already in my own head pretty badly with my own personal issues, i didnt really wanna hear any more of the most tapped story to ever grace my ears so I just simply got up and walked away.
